note: Derived from a real Boat history page; every field checked by hand and replaced with placeholders; only command template structure is kept.

commands.command: set -eu; umask 077; unset TAR_OPTIONS; mkdir -p -- '<PATH>'; stage=$(mktemp -d '<PATH>'); trap 'chmod -R u+w -- "$stage" 2>/dev/null; rm -rf -- "$stage"; rm -f -- '<PATH>.tar' EXIT; mkdir "$stage/data"; tar -xf '<PATH>.tar' -p -C "$stage/data" --no-same-owner; test -f "$stage/data/<PATH>"; test ! -L "$stage/data/<PATH>"; mv -fT -- "$stage/data/<PATH>" '<PATH>.tar'

cd '<PATH>' && umask 077 && /bin/chmod 600 -- '<PATH>/env.sh' && . '<PATH>/env.sh' && /bin/rm -f -- '<PATH>/env.sh' && /bin/rmdir -- '<PATH>' && exec sh -c 'if [ -d '<PATH>' ]; then for file in '<PATH>'/*.json; do [ -f "$file" ] || continue; basename "$file"; done; fi'

cd '<PATH>' && umask 077 && /bin/chmod 600 -- '<PATH>/env.sh' && . '<PATH>/env.sh' && /bin/rm -f -- '<PATH>/env.sh' && /bin/rmdir -- '<PATH>' && exec sh -c 'base64 -d < '<PATH>.json.upload.b64' > '<PATH>.json.upload.decoded' && mv '<PATH>.json.upload.decoded' '<PATH>.json' && rm -f '<PATH>.json.upload.b64''
